data.one_liner: A collection of customizable standard and innovative loading animation widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides standard loaders like spinners, pulses, and bounces alongside innovative animated loaders like DNA helices and fractal trees. It also offers developer utilities such as full-screen overlays and future builders.
use_when: You need standard or unique loading animations in your Flutter application.
You want an easy way to block user interaction with an async loading overlay.
avoid_when: You need complex data state management or low-level custom painter utilities outside of loading animations.
strengths: Wide variety of standard and innovative loader animations.
Includes helpful developer utility widgets like LoaderFutureBuilder and loading overlays.
Customizable options for size, colors, stroke width, and animation speed.
weaknesses: Limited to loading animations and UI helpers, which may require combining with other UI libraries for comprehensive design systems.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
